report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with durations 78-344ms; gateway p95 for /v1/checkout is ~437ms with zero 502s, and order/payment metrics show no errors. Traces show a single slow hop (order->inventory ~26ms, order->payment ~23ms) but no failure. Healthy telemetry contradicts a fault hypothesis, and the excluded logs/traces needed to bound any candidate are unavailable, so this is handed off rather than asserted.
